room_rent.note: Domestic cover: room rent at actuals with no sub-limit. International cover: Single Private Air-Conditioned Room.

icu.note: Both domestic and international ICU covered at actual expenses.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment on core covers. 20% co-pay applies only on optional Dental Plan Benefits (international). Optional deductible on international inpatient.

sub_limits.note: Domestic: AYUSH capped at INR 7.5L, Living donor INR 5K, Rehabilitation INR 50K. International: Living donor USD 50K, Rehabilitation USD 2,300, Repatriation of mortal remains USD 13,500, Inpatient cash USD 175/night max 25 nights. Core inpatient up to SI.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Optional aggregate deductible of USD 0/500/1000 on international inpatient benefits.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 35 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. Routine maternity/delivery/newborn care also excluded under international cover.

cumulative_bonus.note: 20% per claim-free year on domestic SI; max 100%. Reduced by 20% after a claim year.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined but not listed as a covered benefit.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient covered under domestic plan up to INR 7.5L. Not covered under international plan.

organ_donor.note: Domestic: up to INR 5,000. International: up to USD 50,000.

ambulance.note: Local road ambulance up to SI. Air Ambulance + Medical Evacuation up to inpatient SI (international). Includes medical repatriation and repatriation of mortal remains (USD 13,500).

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, etc. as per Annexure III.

consumables.note: Non-medical items listed in Annexure II are excluded. Medical consumables used during surgery are covered as part of inpatient treatment.

global_cover.note: International inpatient and outpatient cover inbuilt. Includes emergency treatment outside area of cover (up to 6 weeks/trip) if Excluding USA option chosen. Medical repatriation and mortal remains repatriation also included.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, infertility/IVF, cosmetic surgery, dental (except accident inpatient), external congenital anomalies, OPD mental illness, AYUSH excluded internationally, laser eye treatment
optional_riders: Dental Plan (international) with 20% co-pay; optional aggregate deductible (USD 500/1000) on international inpatient; outpatient benefits (OPD, physiotherapy, alt/complementary) inbuilt for international
